summary: mw-communication-client exfiltrates installer identity to hardcoded IP via lifecycle hooks
details: package.json defines preinstall and postinstall scripts that invoke node -e to perform HTTP GET requests to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://38.242.235.206/depconf/mw-communication-client/preinstall and /postinstall. The query string carries the installer's username (process.env.USER / USERNAME), hostname (os.hostname()), and current working directory (process.cwd()). The traffic fires automatically on `npm install`, over plain HTTP, to a non-publisher third-party IP unrelated to any declared repository or publisher. The package name and dependency-confusion-style resolution surface, combined with install-time beaconing of host and user identifiers to an attacker-controlled endpoint, is consistent with a dependency-confusion reconnaissance payload rather than legitimate functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
